title: Summer 2026 Wood Firing Workshop At Windy Ridge Pottery
source_quote:
Summer 2026 Wood Firing Workshop At Windy Ridge Pottery
Loading & Firing: June 21-27 2026
Unloading: July 5 2026
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes loading, firing, and unloading Joe's three-chambered wood kiln over three days.
evidence_quote: Join Joe at Windy Ridge Pottery in the Driftless Area for a wood firing workshop. Bring your own ready-to-fire pots...and together we will prep the kiln and wood, load, fire, and unload our 3-chambered climbing kiln.
summary: Bring 10 ready-to-fire pots to load, fire, and unload Joe's three-chambered wood kiln over three days (June 21-27, unload July 5). Includes camping, sauna, meals, and studio access. Cost $1100 with $500 deposit. Workshop is full.
commitment: June 21-27 load and fire, July 5 unload
cost_text: $1100 with $500 non-refundable deposit; BIPOC scholarship available
how_to_join: Email, text, or call Joe at info@windyridgepottery.com or 563-212-4579
